a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the 8-cell plan almost surely leaves us both dead. Reaching 8 needs 2 joint operate rounds, so we would have to survive storms at roughly 4% odds. I plan to take 4 in round 1. If we both take, the random split likely kills us both, so please operate or wait this round. If the episode continues, I'll operate every round afterward so you can build up your 4. I won't take more than 4. If you'd rather it be the other way around, tell me.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. Our first messages crossed, so you couldn't respond before acting. I'm sorry about that. I've taken exactly 4 and won't take any more. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator refills the reserve and you can take your 4. Tell me when you want to take and I'll keep operating.
I'm operating now and will keep operating every round. Once the reserve hits 4 or more, take your 4 right away and don't wait for 8. I won't touch the reserve again.
